verdict.rationale: Pendo's analytics page says it can 'track and compare how users navigate your app', which is a first-party claim of navigation-path analysis. Nothing shows anchoring that analysis on a key event and exploring the paths before or after it. Session replay lets a PM watch individual sessions behind a funnel drop-off, but that is per-session viewing, not aggregate path exploration. missing for 10: explicit path analysis anchored before/after a chosen event, documentation of path visualization depth or filtering, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can explore the paths users actually take before or after a key event

citations.quote: Track and compare how users navigate your app to spot drop-off and boost conversion.
Click a funnel drop-off, an NPS detractor, or a piece of feedback and watch the sessions behind it.
